<reaction> After taking your initial mulligan: Take an additional mulligan for up to 2 cards.
You begin each game with 2 fewer resources.

front.flavor_text: Many choices lie ahead. None of them will be easy.
front.subtitle: Damned If You Don't
front.text:
Permanent. Limit 1 <name> per deck. Purchase at deck creation.
You may not mulligan non-weakness cards from your opening hand. 
Your opening hand size is increased by 2.

Uses (2 supplies). If <name> has no supplies, discard it.
<for> When an investigator at your location resolves a <cultist>, <elder_thing>, or <fail> token during a skill test: Remove 1 supply from <name>. 
<free> Exhaust <name>: Your current location gets –1 shroud until the end of your turn.

front.flavor_text: "Every scar is a story... Some are better than others."
front.subtitle: Heart on Your Sleeve
front.text:
Permanent. Purchase at deck creation.
Your investigator's Deckbuilding Restrictions gain: "No <t>Clothing</t> assets that take up a body slot."
You have 2 additional body slots, which can only be used to hold <t>Brand</t> assets.
front.title: <unique><name>

front.flavor_text:
"It is better to be a warrior in a garden
than a gardener in a war."
front.text:
You get +1 <agility> while evading. 
<reaction> When a non-<t>Elite</t> enemy would engage you, discard <name>: Exhaust that enemy instead.

front.flavor_text: Blink and you'll miss it.
front.text:
Fast. Play during any <free> window.
Ready a non-weakness asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Exile <name>.

front.flavor_text:
Local legends tell of a hound so loyal 
that it took up its deceased master's mantle 
as protector of Minakami's shrines.
front.subtitle: Sentinel of the Shrines
front.text: <reaction> After an enemy is defeated at your location, exhaust Koromaru: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location.
front.title: <unique><name>

front.flavor_text:
"Do not concern yourself with "destiny," child... 
In this world, there is no fate but the one we make."
front.text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional tarot slot.

front.flavor_text:
Early pioneers in the field of aviation found 
they lacked the vocabulary to describe the 
unnatural state of "unlimited visibility" that 
accompanied an exceptionally clear day.
front.text:
Attach <name> to your current location. Limit 1 per location.
The attached location and each connecting location get –1 shroud.

front.subtitle: If It Means a Lot to You
front.text:
Permanent.
Your investigator's Deckbuilding Restrictions gain: "Exactly 1 asset that takes up ally slots." 
<reaction> Before you draw your opening hand or when your deck is empty: Search your deck and discard pile for an asset that takes up an ally slot and attach it to <name>.
Cards attached to <name> may be played as if they were in your hand.
front.title: <unique><name>

front.flavor_text:
"No one should reach nirvana without the taste 
of good saké on their lips."
front.subtitle: The Monk
front.text: You begin the game with Hair of the Dog (Absinthe Elixir) in play. Spend 1 supply from Hair of the Dog: You get +1 skill value for this test. (Limit once per turn.) effect: +X. X is the number of supplies on Hair of the Dog.
front.title: <unique><name>

front.flavor_text:
"If they don't answer your prayers... 
Why do you worship them?"
front.text: After this skill test ends, add 2 <blessing> tokens to the chaos bag. If this skill test fails, also add 2 <curse> tokens to the chaos bag after this test ends.
